svg.aria-label: The architecture of Haru, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model, shown over five frames as it says Hi there how are you. In every frame the speech tokenizer turns incoming user speech into a speech latent, which is summed with the model's previous text token and previous speech latent into one position of the language model. The single output of the language model branches into a text head, which predicts the next text token, and a speech head, which predicts the next speech latent. The text tokenizer turns the token into text and the speech tokenizer turns the latent into model speech. Both predictions become the text and model inputs of the following frame.
svg.text: One language model listens and speaks at once, predicting text and speech together in every frame
